name: Load
signature: void __thiscall Load(C_ItemDef * this, int * outSize, void * data)
plate_comment:
Stream layout (offsets from data):
  0x00 char fpvModel[20]   0x14 char image[20]   0x28 char model[20]
  0x3c int unknown0c       0x40 16 unused bytes  0x50 char displayName[20] (ignored)
  0x64 textId  0x68 weight  0x6c inventorySize  0x70 category  0x74 unknown3c
  0x78 armedSound  0x7c team
  0x80 int component kind+1 (0 = none), component data (its Save size),
       int secondary component kind+1, its data, 0x20 reserved bytes.
*outSize = bytes consumed; derived classes read their fields at data + *outSize.
